description: Figure 3 is a pie chart that illustrates the distribution of subtasks within the MMRA benchmark. The chart is composed of ten distinct, colored slices, each representing a different subtask. The subtasks and their corresponding sample counts and proportions are as follows: ObservationAngle (126 samples, 12.28%), SimilarMaterial (106 samples, 10.33%), SubEvent (100 samples, 9.74%), UsageSimilarity (100 samples, 9.65%), Environment (90 samples, 8.77%), Layout (90 samples, 8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (90 samples, 8.77%), SimilarEvent (90 samples, 8.77%), MentalitySimilarity (89 samples, 8.67%), RelativePosition (81 samples, 7.90%), and NearSameEntity (63 samples, 6.34%). The chart visually represents the proportion of each subtask, with the largest slice corresponding to ObservationAngle and the smallest to NearSameEntity. The integers inside each slice denote the number of samples, and the percentages in parentheses indicate the proportion of each task in the entire benchmark.
